content:
mika: Huge shoutout to infra + ops — you saved the canary roll last night. Stayed up, debugged the kernel mismatch, and rolled back the model variant. Pizza + drinks on me tomorrow in the kitchen 🍕🙏
javier: Insane work. Coffee and pizza for the team = my new favorite combo ☕️🍕 (reaction :partyparrot:)
priya: Saw the threads — you all handled it so calmly. Thank you @infra-team and @ops-team!
ops-bot: incident update: rollback completed, canary traffic reverted. run_id: `c-9832-rollback`. All services green.
zoe: Honestly, watching the logs at 1:20am felt dramatic. Huge props to everyone who stayed. I'll bring napkins and extra plates :)
tom: Can we get one gluten-free pizza option? My partner's on GF and I'd like them to enjoy too.
ella: I'll bring sodas and forks. Also taped a little 'thanks' note to the kitchen whiteboard. Emoji stickers included :sparkles:
mika: Amazing — I'm putting $80 on my card for tomorrow. If anyone wants to Venmo, DM me (venmo @mika-pay). See you at lunch, heroes.
raj: Seriously legendary teamwork. Thanks for being there for the product and each other :muscle:
